english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Seed Grain that shall be formed by the Elements, and also be destroyed by them
english_classification.chapter_note: Short, heavily damaged chapter preserving a substrate teaching about the dual nature of cosmic processes in the world of mixture: the same elements that form and nourish also destroy. The teaching maps this principle across agricultural (seed/tree), cosmic (five elements/righteousness), and material (Matter's shadow) domains. Only clear editorial intrusion is 'the teachers and the elect' in ¶3. Gardner notes the meaning is unclear, but the substrate structure is a cosmological principle about formation-and-destruction as inseparable in mixture. Chapter title itself encapsulates the substrate teaching. Very little editorial overlay for such a short chapter.
